items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: TH: Yes, please. I need to move this. ... TH: We were supposed to have a suite and this is what we have.

ctx.x: So I sang through that. So I mean isn’t that funny, I had to re-learn that many a time.
Do we need to stop, Tim? TH: Yes, please. I need to move this. When you shift you’re getting pinched here and I’m going to bring this around the others side.
